# Cybersecurity AI Startup - Project Setup Instructions

This project is a sophisticated Next.js application for a cybersecurity AI startup with WebGL effects and modern dark theme design.

## Project Structure
- Next.js with TypeScript
- Dark theme with purple/magenta gradients
- WebGL effects and animations
- MVC architecture pattern
- Modern UI components
- Cybersecurity focused design

## Development Guidelines
- Use TypeScript for type safety
- Follow MVC pattern for code organization
- Implement responsive design
- Focus on performance optimization
- Maintain cybersecurity theme consistency
